name: Phillip A. Thompson
role: Senior Vice President of Client Experience, Kepner-Tregoe
bio: Phillip is Senior Vice President of Client Experience at Kepner-Tregoe, working with organizations and senior leaders around the world to strengthen problem-solving, decision-making, leadership, and organizational performance. His career spans nearly four decades and more than 30 countries across a wide range of industries. He previously served as President of Shainin for Europe and Asia and CEO of a German automotive tier-1 supplier. His background gives him extensive practical experience with multiple approaches to structured problem solving, continuous improvement, and root cause analysis. A former U.S. Army officer, Phillip holds a master’s degree in international business and speaks English, German, French, and Spanish. He regularly delivers keynote speeches, executive sessions and leadership workshops for organizations around the world, combining practical operating experience with structured approaches to solving complex problems. He is based in Munich, Germany, with his family.

history.title: The Problem Solving Transmission: Making the Shift Happen
